subject: Parental Dementia History Drives Immune Aging Without Accelerating Brain Age
script: From Agewell Brief: Parental Dementia History Drives Immune Aging Without Accelerating Brain Age. Middle-aged adults with a parental history of dementia display a distinct immune shift toward memory T cells rather than generalized neural aging. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
